page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. This instance is configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps to support high-throughput networking requirements. The lack of integrated GPUs or local NVMe storage represents a design tradeoff, focusing resources entirely on raw CPU compute density and network connectivity.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c8a.32xlarge offers a high density of dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores relative to memory, making it a viable option for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk storage. Suitable workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive web serving, and distributed compute tasks.
